title: BehaviorSpec
description: Typed behavior sublanguage carried inside DesignSpec.goal / DesignSpec.objectives. Compiled from natural language; serializable, editable and testable. NOTE: hand-authored first cut for Phase 1 — to be wired into webapp/scripts/gen_schemas.jl (struct-generated) so the CI drift-guard covers it.
$comment: This is the AUTHORED / NL-facing NESTED form. It is intentionally DIFFERENT from the FLAT `behavior_spec` block in the benchmark task JSONs (benchmarks/tasks/*.json), which is a LOWERED verifier query (flat shape-gate keys like rise_slope_max / fall_slope_min / plateau_width_log10_input_min, per the roadmap Task Format) consumed directly by run_benchmark.jl. They share a name but not a schema — this schema does NOT validate the task blocks. Convergence (NL compiler emits THIS nested form, then a lowering step produces the flat gates) is a Phase-5 item; until then they are two layers, not one format.

behavior_class.description: Vocabulary v0 class. 'bandpass_like' is a user-language alias resolved by the compiler to biphasic_peak or bandpass_with_plateau after checking for a true high-input falloff.

input_axis.description: Swept axis. 'plateau'/'range' refer to width along this log axis, NOT real-time duration.

shape_preferences.description: Soft preferences / numeric gates on per-curve metrics (names match the phenotyper output fields).

min_robustness_score.description: Lower bound on shape_support (the distributional robustness number) under the declared phenotyper_version.

compilation_notes.description: Per-phrase notes recording how ambiguous language was interpreted (e.g. whether 'longer plateau' meant plateau_width_log10_input vs real time).

kd_profile.description: Coarse Kd language compiled to explicit numeric/relative constraints (Kd-semantics section).

scale_ref.description: Concentration/total-input scale a relative bin is defined against.
